info.title: Plain-language lint rules, judged by Jev (System One API) one scope at a time.
info.description: Plain-language lint rules judged by a model (Jev, by TypeSafe), scoped with tree-sitter

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Tree-sitter cuts each file into class / method / function scopes; every rule that
matches a scope is asked as its own keyed question about that scope.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Judge the scopes against the rules

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to lintent.toml (default: found by walking up from the current directory)

options.name: --rule
options.description: Only these rules; repeatable

options.name: --changed
options.description: Only files changed since the merge-base with --base, plus uncommitted and untracked files

options.name: --trust-grammars
options.description: Allow runtime grammars from [languages.*] (native code) to be compiled and loaded. Also granted by LINTENT_TRUST_GRAMMARS=1 in the environment

options.name: --base
options.description: Base ref for --changed (default: origin/main, falling back to main)

options.name: --json
options.description: Print JSON: {findings, errors, stats}

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the exact request bodies instead of sending them (no API key needed)

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Neither read nor write the cache

options.name: --refresh
options.description: Ask again for everything and overwrite the cached verdicts

options.name: --max-cost
options.description: Budget for this run in USD (default: [budget] max_cost_usd, 0.001). Over it, nothing is sent (exit 3)

options.name: --fail-on
options.description: Lowest severity whose confident fails set exit 1: error (default) or warning [default: error]

options.name: --help
options.description: Print help
